description:
The Quartz Cruiser XL has built a loyal following among cruiser racers, establishing itself as our go-to 24"" workhorse. Built around our aftermarket Quartz Cruiser frame and equipped with a full Pro-level component package, this bike delivers championship-inspired performance in a race-ready cruiser setup.
No detail has been overlooked, from our innovative Sliding Disc Dropout System (SDDS) and Argon Pro rims to premium components from Tioga. Every part has been carefully selected to provide the speed, reliability, and confidence demanded by serious cruiser riders. Whether you're chasing podiums or simply enjoying the unique feel of 24"" racing, the Quartz Cruiser XL is built to perform.

FRAME: hydroformed 6061-T6 alloy frame, tapered headtube, forged dropouts, with int. chaintensioners

STEM: ARISE "NEON PRO" toploader stem, ext. 54mm, cnc machined, alloy

components.description: RADIO RACELINE "BSA24" bb set, external bearing cups, cnc machined, sealed
ARISE "XENON" disc brake, rear
ARISE "XENON" disc brake lever, rear
KMC "Z6" chain, 1/2" x 3/32"
ARISE "XENON PRO" sprocket, 44T, alloy
RADIO RACELINE driver, 16T, 1/2"- 3/32", sealed cassette
ARISE, Xenon Pro, 2pc crank, cold forged/cnc, alloy, 180mm length, 24mm spindle
crmo fork, 1-1/8" butted steerer, crmo fork legs, 30mm offset
RADIO RACELINE "XENON" grips, diamond knurling, clamp on grip, 139mm length
4130 crmo bar, seamless
RADIO RACELINE "PRO" integrated headset, sealed, threadless, 1-1/8" - 1.5", including fork crown race 1.5"-1 1/8" converter
ARISE "BRAVO" front hub, alloy cnc, fully sealed, 36h, 3/8" female crmo axle
ARISE "BRAVO" rear hub, alloy cnc, fully sealed, 36h, disc brake cassette, 6 pawl, 3/8" female crmo axle
RADIO RACELINE "XENON SLIM" pedal, alloy
ARISE "ARGON PRO" rim, flash welded, 36h, tubeless ready, alloy
ARISE "XENON" pivotal seat, no padding
RADIO RACELINE pivotal seat post, 27.2mm, alloy
ARISE "XENON" seat post, quick-release, alloy
ARISE "NEON PRO" toploader stem, ext. 54mm, cnc machined, alloy
TIOGA "FASTR" tires, front: 24" x 1.75" and rear: 24" x 1.75"
